scripts.build-run: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.cypress:run:all: npm run cypress:run:chrome && npm run cypress:run:firefox
scripts.cypress:run:chrome: start-server-and-test 'npm run build-run' http://localhost:3000 'cypress run --browser chrome'
